label: folio-assistant vocabulary (bootstrap only)
comment: Every class and property the folio knowledge graph projects, one node each. Generated by scripts/ns-export.ts; graph-kind definitions are read from the declaration registry rather than restated here.

@graph.label: Actor
@graph.comment: A concrete participant — human, agentic or mechanical — that persists across processes and takes on a role in each.
@graph.definition: A concrete participant — human, agentic or mechanical — that persists across processes and takes on a role in each.

@graph.label: Role
@graph.comment: A BPMN swimlane: the persona an actor takes on because of the lane it is acting in, carrying that lane's skills.
@graph.definition: A BPMN swimlane: the persona an actor takes on because of the lane it is acting in, carrying that lane's skills.

@graph.label: Skill
@graph.comment: The instruction body an actor needs to perform a task.
@graph.definition: The instruction body an actor needs to perform a task.

@graph.label: Process
@graph.comment: A BPMN process: lanes that bind roles, activities that name skills, and the flow between them.
@graph.definition: A BPMN process: lanes that bind roles, activities that name skills, and the flow between them.

@graph.label: ProcessNode
@graph.comment: One element of a process — an activity, a gateway, a start or end event.
@graph.definition: One element of a process — an activity, a gateway, a start or end event.

@graph.label: SequenceFlow
@graph.comment: A directed edge between two process nodes.
@graph.definition: A directed edge between two process nodes.

@graph.label: Directory
@graph.comment: A declared place to look, naming the kinds of graph found in it.
@graph.definition: A declared place to look, naming the kinds of graph found in it.

@graph.label: Asset
@graph.comment: A file an instance declares as its own, with the role that file plays for it — the instance saying what something IS rather than a scan inferring it.
@graph.definition: A file an instance declares as its own, with the role that file plays for it — the instance saying what something IS rather than a scan inferring it.

@graph.label: GraphKind
@graph.comment: What a declared directory holds — the vocabulary a consumer matches on to decide whether to scan it.
@graph.definition: What a declared directory holds — the vocabulary a consumer matches on to decide whether to scan it.

@graph.label: KGraph
@graph.comment: The harness layer's own knowledge graph, where a directory holds more than one of its parts.
@graph.definition: The harness layer's own knowledge graph, where a directory holds more than one of its parts.

@graph.label: SchemaGraph
@graph.comment: Schema definitions, self-declared in the smart-base manner.
@graph.definition: Schema definitions, self-declared in the smart-base manner.
